user.title: Inverter Setup
user.description: Configure your inverter type and grid voltage.

data_description.inverter_type: Select 'Hybrid' if your inverter has a battery connected.
data_description.grid_voltage: Your local grid voltage (typically 230V in Europe, 120V in North America).

sensors.title: Sensor Mapping
sensors.description: Map your Home Assistant sensors to PV Excess Control. You must provide either a Grid Export sensor or a Combined Import/Export sensor.

data_description.pv_power: Sensor that reports your current PV production (W or kW — automatically converted).
data_description.grid_export: Sensor that reports power exported to the grid (W or kW — automatically converted).
data_description.import_export_power: Combined sensor where positive = export, negative = import (W or kW — automatically converted). Use this instead of Grid Export if your inverter provides a combined sensor.
data_description.load_power: Sensor that reports your total household load (W or kW — automatically converted).
data_description.battery_soc: Sensor that reports battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.battery_power: Combined sensor where positive = charging, negative = discharging (W or kW — automatically converted). Use this OR the separate charge/discharge sensors below.
data_description.battery_charge_power: Sensor that reports battery charging power (W or kW — automatically converted). Use with Battery Discharge Sensor as an alternative to the combined Battery Power Sensor.
data_description.battery_discharge_power: Sensor that reports battery discharging power (W or kW — automatically converted). Use with Battery Charge Sensor as an alternative to the combined Battery Power Sensor.
data_description.battery_capacity: Total usable battery capacity in kilowatt-hours.

energy.title: Energy Pricing
energy.description: Configure your electricity tariff for smart scheduling.

data_description.tariff_provider: Select your electricity price provider integration.
data_description.price_sensor: Select the sensor entity that provides the current electricity price. For Tibber, use the price sensor. For Octopus, select the electricity price sensor. For Awattar/Nordpool, select the spot price sensor.
data_description.cheap_price_threshold: Price below which electricity is considered cheap.
data_description.battery_charge_price_threshold: Price below which battery charging from grid is allowed.
data_description.feed_in_tariff: Price received per kWh for energy exported to the grid.
data_description.feed_in_tariff_sensor: Optional sensor for dynamic feed-in tariff (overrides static value)

forecast.title: Solar Forecast
forecast.description: Configure solar production forecast for intelligent planning.

data_description.forecast_provider: Select your solar forecast provider integration.
data_description.forecast_sensor: Select the sensor entity that provides the solar forecast. For Solcast, select the forecast sensor that contains detailedForecast data (e.g., sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_today).
data_description.forecast_tomorrow_sensor: Optional sensor for tomorrow's total forecast (e.g., sensor.solcast_pv_forecast_forecast_tomorrow). Enables weather pre-planning.
data_description.additional_forecast_sensors: Forecasts for additional PV arrays. Duplicate entity IDs are counted once.
data_description.additional_forecast_tomorrow_sensors: Together with the single tomorrow sensor, these sources replace the tomorrow portion of the primary forecasts.

battery.title: Battery Strategy
battery.description: Configure how your battery should be managed alongside appliance control.

data.inverter_force_charge_mode_entity: Inverter mode entity (optional, e.g. EMS mode select)
data.inverter_battery_max_charge_power_entity: Inverter Battery Max Charge Power Entity
data.battery_pv_forecast_factor: PV forecast factor for grid charging

data_description.battery_strategy: How to prioritize battery charging vs. appliance control.
data_description.battery_target_soc: Desired solar-charge level by the target time. The independent grid-charge target limits purchased energy.
data_description.battery_target_time: Time by which the battery should reach the target SoC.
data_description.allow_grid_charging: Allow charging the battery from the grid during cheap tariff periods.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_entity: Entity to control maximum battery discharge power.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_default: Default maximum discharge power when no override is active.
data_description.min_battery_soc: When battery SoC drops below this threshold, all non-essential appliances are shed and battery discharge is blocked. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.auto_battery_grid_charge: Plan grid charging using prices, household demand, solar forecast and losses. Requires valid inputs and acknowledged inverter commands.
data_description.battery_grid_charge_power_w: Target charging power in Watts when force-charging from the grid.
data_description.grid_charge_engage_min_duration_minutes: Minimum number of minutes the cheap window must last before engaging force-charge.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_enable_entity: Entity used to command the inverter into or out of forced grid-charge mode (select, switch, or input_boolean).
data_description.inverter_force_charge_enable_engage_valu: The value to write to the enable entity to start force-charging (e.g. 'Forced charge', 'on').
data_description.inverter_force_charge_enable_disengage_v: The value to write to the enable entity to stop force-charging (e.g. 'Stop (default)', 'off').
data_description.inverter_force_charge_mode_entity: Optional second entity for inverters that need a separate mode command (e.g. EMS mode selector).
data_description.inverter_force_charge_mode_engage_value: Value to write to the mode entity when engaging force-charge (e.g. 'Forced mode').
data_description.inverter_force_charge_mode_disengage_val: Value to write to the mode entity when disengaging force-charge (e.g. 'Self-consumption mode').
data_description.inverter_force_charge_power_entity: Number or input_number entity for the forced-charge power setpoint. Required for forecast-aware grid charging to deliver the planned energy; optional for manual-only charging. Input helpers require a physical readback.
data_description.dynamic_battery_charge_enabled: When enabled, the integration writes a watts value to the configured inverter entity each cycle to throttle/maximize battery charging based on a forecast-derived curve and the configured export soft ceiling. Requires a forecast provider, battery capacity, battery SoC sensor, and a configured export limit. Default off.
data_description.inverter_battery_max_charge_power_entity: Writable HA entity that accepts watts as the battery max charging power. Must be a number or input_number entity. Battery First also respects its current limit, including zero.
data_description.battery_max_charge_power_w: Verified native charging limit for PV and the battery, separate from the requested grid-charge power. Required for forecast-aware grid charging even when dynamic solar charging is off, so future solar absorption is modeled correctly. Entering this value does not enable power control. Also bounds Battery First and dynamic solar charging.
data_description.battery_trickle_charge_power_w: Minimum value the integration writes when deferring charging in the morning. Default 100 W to satisfy hardware that rejects exactly 0.
data_description.battery_grid_target_soc: Upper limit for grid charging. The plan may stop earlier when forecast demand is covered. Solar charging keeps its separate target.
data_description.battery_roundtrip_efficiency: Fraction of purchased energy available later, from 0.5 to 1. Default 0.85 is a planning assumption, not a measured battery efficiency.
data_description.battery_wear_cost_per_kwh: Optional assumed wear cost per later delivered kWh. Default 0; 0.03 means 3 ct/kWh. Added to purchase price divided by round-trip efficiency.
data_description.battery_soc_hysteresis: Charge again only after SoC has fallen this far below the grid target, to avoid repeated small charging cycles.
data_description.battery_input_max_age_seconds: Automatic charging requires fresh SoC and required measurement inputs. Allow several sensor polling intervals; default 300 seconds.
data_description.battery_forecast_max_age_seconds: Reject automatic plans when solar forecast inputs are older than this limit. Default 21600 seconds (6 hours).
data_description.battery_load_profile_w: JSON list of 24 average watts values for local hours 00–23, e.g. [500, 500, ...]. Exclude EV charging and other separately scheduled loads. Leave empty to learn demand; all 24 local hours need at least 30 minutes of valid samples, usually at least one day, before using the learned profile.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_enable_feedback_en: Physical inverter readback of the requested charging or stop command. Required for charging when the command uses an input helper.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_mode_feedback_enti: Physical inverter readback of forced or self-consumption mode. Required for charging when the mode uses an input helper.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_power_feedback_ent: Physical readback of the inverter power setpoint in watts, not the instantaneous battery flow. Required when charging uses an input_number helper.
data_description.battery_hold_verified: Enable only after verifying that the mapped command truly prevents battery discharge and that release restores self-consumption. A 100 W discharge limit is not a complete hold. Default off.
data_description.battery_hold_entity: Optional dedicated command for holding energy until expensive hours. Must have separate engage and release values.
data_description.battery_hold_engage_value: Value that prevents battery discharge, such as on. Only use a physically verified mapping.
data_description.battery_hold_release_value: Value that restores normal self-consumption, such as off.
data_description.battery_hold_feedback_entity: Physical feedback of hold/release. Mandatory and distinct from the command when using an input helper.
data_description.battery_hold_feedback_engage_value: Expected physical readback while holding. Leave empty to use the hold command value.
data_description.battery_hold_feedback_release_value: Expected physical readback after release. Leave empty to use the release command value.
data_description.battery_pv_forecast_factor: Scale PV only for battery grid-charge planning: 0.9 means 90% of the forecast. Range 0.1–1.0; default 1.0 leaves forecasts unchanged. Calibrate using past forecasts available at planning time and subsequent measured production. Solar and appliance planning remain unchanged.

settings.title: Global Settings
settings.description: Configure global behavior, update intervals, and notification preferences.

data_description.export_limit: Maximum power allowed to export to the grid (0 = no limit).
data_description.off_threshold: Shutdown threshold in watts (−500 to +500). Positive values retain an export buffer during solar starts and current adjustments.
data_description.controller_interval: How often the controller evaluates and adjusts appliances.
data_description.planner_interval: How often the planner recalculates the daily schedule.
data_description.plan_influence: Controls how the 24-hour planner influences real-time decisions. 'Light' lowers activation thresholds when the plan expects excess. 'Plan follows' actively schedules appliances based on forecast and tariff predictions. 'None' disables plan influence (pure reactive control).
data_description.enable_preemption: When enabled, the optimizer can shed lower-priority appliances to start higher-priority ones that lack sufficient excess power. Disable to use simple priority-based allocation only.
data_description.notify_appliance_on: Send a notification when an appliance is turned on by the integration.
data_description.notify_appliance_off: Send a notification when an appliance is turned off by the integration.
data_description.notify_daily_summary: Send a daily summary notification at midnight with energy stats.
data_description.on_threshold: Optional global fallback in watts. Appliance-specific values take precedence. Empty keeps the defaults: 200 W for fixed loads, 50 W for dynamic loads.

error.invalid_voltage: Grid voltage must be between 100V and 500V.
error.no_grid_sensor: You must configure at least one of: Grid Export sensor, Combined Import/Export sensor, or Load Power sensor.
error.missing_price_sensor: A price sensor is required when a tariff provider is selected.
error.missing_forecast_sensor: A forecast sensor is required when a forecast provider is selected.
error.invalid_soc: State of charge must be between 0% and 100%.
error.missing_inverter_battery_charge_entity: An inverter battery max charge power entity is required when dynamic battery charging is enabled.
error.missing_battery_max_charge_power: Battery max charge power is required when dynamic battery charging is enabled.
error.battery_max_charge_below_trickle: Battery max charge power must be greater than the trickle charge power.
error.missing_export_limit_for_dynamic_charge: Export limit must be set when dynamic battery charging is enabled.
error.invalid_battery_setting: Enter a finite value within the allowed range; charge targets must not be below the reserve.
error.invalid_battery_load_profile: Enter a JSON list of exactly 24 finite, nonnegative watt values.
error.missing_physical_battery_feedback: Select a distinct physical readback entity; an input helper cannot confirm the inverter command.
error.invalid_battery_hold: A verified hold needs a command entity and distinct hold/release values and readbacks.
error.missing_battery_grid_power_entity: Select an adjustable charging power entity for automatic grid charging.
error.invalid_battery_native_charge_power: Enter a finite, positive native maximum battery charging power in watts.

abort.already_configured: PV Excess Control is already configured.

appliance.title: Appliance
appliance.description: Add an appliance to be controlled based on excess PV power or cheap grid tariffs.

user.title: Add Appliance
user.description: Configure the basic information and power profile for this appliance.

data_description.appliance_name: A friendly name for this appliance.
data_description.appliance_entity: The switch or controllable entity for this appliance.
data_description.appliance_priority: Lower number = higher priority. Appliances with higher priority get excess power first.
data_description.nominal_power: The rated power consumption of this appliance in watts.
data_description.actual_power_entity: Optional sensor that reports actual power consumption (W or kW — automatically converted).
data_description.phases: Number of electrical phases this appliance uses.

current.title: Dynamic Current Settings
current.description: Configure dynamic current control for variable-power appliances like EV chargers.

data_description.dynamic_current: Enable to control this appliance by adjusting its current rather than simple on/off.
data_description.current_entity: Number entity to set the charging current.
data_description.current_step: Resolution of current adjustments. 0.1A for fine-grained control, 1.0A for whole-amp steps. Match this to your device's supported resolution.
data_description.cheap_grid_target_current: Target current during cheap tariff windows when grid supplementation is enabled. Defaults to max_current. Capped by max_grid_power if set. Leave empty to use min_current (legacy behaviour).
data_description.ev_soc_entity: Sensor that reports the EV battery state of charge.
data_description.ev_connected_entity: Binary sensor that indicates whether the EV is connected.
data_description.ev_target_soc: Stop charging when EV reaches this state of charge (%)
data_description.current_update_interval: Delay automatic increases after a successful current change. Reductions and manual overrides remain immediate. 0 disables the delay.
data_description.current_min_change: Ignore automatic increases smaller than this value. Reductions remain immediate. 0 disables the minimum.
data_description.phase_count_entity: Optional integer 1–3 for power accounting. Zero or unavailable retains the last valid count (configured phases at startup). Does not switch charger hardware.

constraints.title: Constraints & Grid Settings
constraints.description: Configure runtime constraints, grid supplementation, and big consumer settings.

data_description.switch_interval: Minimum time between switching this appliance on and off.
data_description.averaging_window: Custom averaging window for excess power calculation. Shorter windows respond faster but may cause more switching. Leave empty to use the global default (1800 seconds / 30 minutes).
data_description.on_only: If enabled, this appliance will only be turned on, never automatically turned off.
data_description.protect_from_preemption: When enabled, this appliance will never be shed to make room for a higher-priority appliance.
data_description.min_daily_runtime: Minimum number of minutes this appliance should run per day.
data_description.max_daily_runtime: Maximum number of minutes this appliance may run per day.
data_description.max_daily_activations: Maximum number of times this appliance may be turned on per day. Leave empty for unlimited.
data_description.on_threshold: Extra excess power (watts) required above the appliance's minimum to trigger activation. Leave empty for default (200 W standard, 50 W dynamic current).
data_description.completion_power_threshold: Power (in watts) below which the appliance is considered done. When set, cycles where actual power is below this threshold won't count toward daily runtime. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.schedule_deadline: Time by which the minimum daily runtime must be completed.
data_description.start_after: Earliest time this appliance may operate. Leave empty for no restriction.
data_description.end_before: Latest time this appliance may operate. Leave empty for no restriction.
data_description.allow_grid_supplement: Allow using grid power when the energy price is cheap. The price threshold can be configured below, or falls back to the global cheap price threshold.
data_description.max_grid_power: Maximum watts to draw from the grid during cheap-tariff supplementation.
data_description.cheap_price_threshold: Price threshold below which grid supplementation is allowed for this appliance. Leave empty to use the global threshold.
data_description.is_big_consumer: Mark as big consumer to control battery discharge when active. Set 'Battery Discharge Override' below to define the discharge limit.
data_description.battery_discharge_override: Override battery max discharge power (in watts) when this appliance is active.
data_description.requires_appliance: Select an appliance that must be running before this one can start. E.g., a pool heat pump requires the pool pump.
data_description.helper_only: When enabled, this appliance only runs when another appliance lists it as its required dependency. It will never run on its own based on excess power.
data_description.enable_condition_entity: Optional binary sensor or input boolean. Off or unavailable blocks automatic starts.
data_description.enable_condition_mode: Start only checks before starting. While running also stops an active appliance if the condition is off or unavailable, including on-only devices. Manual override takes precedence.
data_description.start_delay: Continuously sufficient allocated solar power before starting, in seconds. Tariff-funded operation, deadlines and manual override bypass the delay. Configure gates and delays on dependents, not helper-only devices.
data_description.remaining_runtime_entity: Sensor or number helper reporting minutes still required. Zero completes demand; unknown prevents new starts. Cannot be combined with a positive fixed daily minimum.
data_description.require_contiguous_runtime: After starting, continue the requested cycle through solar drops. Requires a positive daily maximum; safety limits remain effective.

Also bounds Battery First and dynamic solar charging.
data_description.battery_trickle_charge_power_w: Minimum value the integration writes when deferring charging in the morning. Default 100 W to satisfy hardware that rejects exactly 0.
data_description.battery_grid_target_soc: Upper limit for grid charging. The plan may stop earlier when forecast demand is covered. Solar charging keeps its separate target.
data_description.battery_roundtrip_efficiency: Fraction of purchased energy available later, from 0.5 to 1. Default 0.85 is a planning assumption, not a measured battery efficiency.
data_description.battery_wear_cost_per_kwh: Optional assumed wear cost per later delivered kWh. Default 0; 0.03 means 3 ct/kWh. Added to purchase price divided by round-trip efficiency.
data_description.battery_soc_hysteresis: Charge again only after SoC has fallen this far below the grid target, to avoid repeated small charging cycles.
data_description.battery_input_max_age_seconds: Automatic charging requires fresh SoC and required measurement inputs. Allow several sensor polling intervals; default 300 seconds.
data_description.battery_forecast_max_age_seconds: Reject automatic plans when solar forecast inputs are older than this limit. Default 21600 seconds (6 hours).
data_description.battery_load_profile_w: JSON list of 24 average watts values for local hours 00–23, e.g. [500, 500, ...]. Exclude EV charging and other separately scheduled loads. Leave empty to learn demand; all 24 local hours need at least 30 minutes of valid samples, usually at least one day, before using the learned profile.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_enable_feedback_en: Physical inverter readback of the requested charging or stop command. Required for charging when the command uses an input helper.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_mode_feedback_enti: Physical inverter readback of forced or self-consumption mode. Required for charging when the mode uses an input helper.
data_description.inverter_force_charge_power_feedback_ent: Physical readback of the inverter power setpoint in watts, not the instantaneous battery flow. Required when charging uses an input_number helper.
data_description.battery_hold_verified: Enable only after verifying that the mapped command truly prevents battery discharge and that release restores self-consumption. A 100 W discharge limit is not a complete hold. Default off.
data_description.battery_hold_entity: Optional dedicated command for holding energy until expensive hours. Must have separate engage and release values.
data_description.battery_hold_engage_value: Value that prevents battery discharge, such as on. Only use a physically verified mapping.
data_description.battery_hold_release_value: Value that restores normal self-consumption, such as off.
data_description.battery_hold_feedback_entity: Physical feedback of hold/release. Mandatory and distinct from the command when using an input helper.
data_description.battery_hold_feedback_engage_value: Expected physical readback while holding. Leave empty to use the hold command value.
data_description.battery_hold_feedback_release_value: Expected physical readback after release. Leave empty to use the release command value.
data_description.battery_pv_forecast_factor: Scale PV only for battery grid-charge planning: 0.9 means 90% of the forecast. Range 0.1–1.0; default 1.0 leaves forecasts unchanged. Calibrate using past forecasts available at planning time and subsequent measured production. Solar and appliance planning remain unchanged.

settings.title: Global Settings
settings.description: Update global behavior, update intervals, and notification preferences.

data_description.export_limit: Maximum power allowed to export to the grid (0 = no limit).
data_description.off_threshold: Shutdown threshold in watts (−500 to +500). Positive values retain an export buffer during solar starts and current adjustments.
data_description.controller_interval: How often the controller evaluates and adjusts appliances.
data_description.planner_interval: How often the planner recalculates the daily schedule.
data_description.plan_influence: Controls how the 24-hour planner influences real-time decisions. 'Light' lowers activation thresholds when the plan expects excess. 'Plan follows' actively schedules appliances based on forecast and tariff predictions. 'None' disables plan influence (pure reactive control).
data_description.enable_preemption: When enabled, the optimizer can shed lower-priority appliances to start higher-priority ones that lack sufficient excess power. Disable to use simple priority-based allocation only.
data_description.notify_appliance_on: Send a notification when an appliance is turned on by the integration.
data_description.notify_appliance_off: Send a notification when an appliance is turned off by the integration.
data_description.notify_daily_summary: Send a daily summary notification at midnight with energy stats.
data_description.on_threshold: Optional global fallback in watts. Appliance-specific values take precedence. Empty keeps the defaults: 200 W for fixed loads, 50 W for dynamic loads.

error.invalid_voltage: Grid voltage must be between 100V and 500V.
error.no_grid_sensor: You must configure at least one of: Grid Export sensor, Combined Import/Export sensor, or Load Power sensor.
error.missing_price_sensor: A price sensor is required when a tariff provider is selected.
error.missing_forecast_sensor: A forecast sensor is required when a forecast provider is selected.
error.invalid_soc: State of charge must be between 0% and 100%.
error.missing_inverter_battery_charge_entity: An inverter battery max charge power entity is required when dynamic battery charging is enabled.
error.missing_battery_max_charge_power: Battery max charge power is required when dynamic battery charging is enabled.
error.battery_max_charge_below_trickle: Battery max charge power must be greater than the trickle charge power.
error.missing_export_limit_for_dynamic_charge: Export limit must be set when dynamic battery charging is enabled.
error.invalid_battery_setting: Enter a finite value within the allowed range; charge targets must not be below the reserve.
error.invalid_battery_load_profile: Enter a JSON list of exactly 24 finite, nonnegative watt values.
error.missing_physical_battery_feedback: Select a distinct physical readback entity; an input helper cannot confirm the inverter command.
error.invalid_battery_hold: A verified hold needs a command entity and distinct hold/release values and readbacks.
error.missing_battery_grid_power_entity: Select an adjustable charging power entity for automatic grid charging.
error.invalid_battery_native_charge_power: Enter a finite, positive native maximum battery charging power in watts.
